title: Why do all my tests show up twice in the test explorer?
summary: When using both the pre-release AL Language extension and AL Test Runner, tests appear twice in the test explorer. The AL Language extension now includes built-in testing capabilities that conflict with AL Test Runner, and there is a bug causing test runs to hang indefinitely against pre-BC28 containers.
key_points: Tests appear twice because both AL Language extension (release version includes test discovery) and AL Test Runner contribute to the test explorer
BC28 supports test execution through the AL Language extension, but earlier versions do not
A bug causes test runs initiated by the AL Language extension to never complete on pre-BC28 containers, blocking Copilot code generation
AL Test Runner currently offers more features (code coverage, performance profiles, page scripts) than Microsoft's extension
AL Test Runner will be maintained until Microsoft's version achieves feature parity
